description_for_human: Generate Agentforce/Slack payment lock, behavior lock, and hybrid lock workflow templates. Build automated access control workflows quickly.
description_for_model: SlackAgent Lock is a professional workflow template generator that creates three types of lock mechanisms: Payment Lock, Behavior Lock, and Hybrid Lock. Each lock type supports dual-platform output for Slack and Agentforce. Users simply input trigger conditions and custom rules to generate ready-to-use workflow template code.
capabilities: 生成支付锁工作流模板
生成行为锁工作流模板
生成混合锁工作流模板
privacy_policy: 本工具不收集任何用户数据，所有操作均在浏览器本地完成，无需登录注册
